scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive acyclic Morse matchings and complete signed Lefschetz character calculations are included and independently checkable by the supplied deterministic Python-standard-library program.
scientific_limitations: Finite 20-vertex graph with vertex shortest-path metric only. No general family theorem, no equivariant sphere-wedge equivalence, and no independent audit claimed. Bibliographic comparison is not proof of priority.
title: Complete graph-metric Vietoris–Rips homotopy and symmetry of the Desargues graph
